newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials see gains, Nasdaq falls slightly.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials see gains, Nasdaq falls slightly.

text.p: The Dow industrial average continued its gains on Tuesday, bypassing the 7500 level, while the technology-heavy Nasdaq faced a minor setback after several days of closing higher.
In late morning trading, the Dow was up about 37 points or 0.49 percent at 7515. The Nasdaq fell about four points to 1408.
The long bond was up 5/32 at a 6.81 percent yield while the Standard & Poor's futures index was up 0.15 to 866.
"The market is just adding to its gains and that will continue as long as there is favorable rotation," said Jonathan Dodd, a technical analyst at Dean Witter.
Analysts said investors were starting to rotate or lighten up on the larger stocks in favor of second-tier and small-capitalization stocks.

Cable companies carried over its support from yesterday, with Tele-Communications Inc up 6/16 to 16-7/16. Also on the Nasdaq, Ascend Communications topped the most active list, down five to 42-5/8, after UBS Securities downgraded the stock from a buy to a hold rating.
